name: blueprint/routes-eta
description: Routes and ETAs from the keyless OSRM public server, composed with places for endpoints and events for ETA reminders
ingredients: guardedFetch OSRM adapter (keyless, public server, light use only)
recipe: geocode origin and destination -> request the route from OSRM and normalize duration + distance -> cache the route with fetchedAt -> schedule an ETA event at the arrival time
pitfalls: the public OSRM server is for light use - cache routes, do not hammer it
geocode results are importance-ranked - confirm the endpoints are the intended places
durations are model-based, not live traffic - say so in the receipt
ETAs are local-time events; freeSlots working hours apply
